name: Revenue & Txn by Outlets
query:
SELECT 
    a.cost_center AS "Originating Outlet:400", 
    SUM(a.grand_total) AS "Total Sales:Currency:200", 
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.name) AS "Invoice Count:Int:100" 
FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice` a 
WHERE 
    a.posting_date BETWEEN %(start)s AND %(end)s 
    AND a.docstatus = 1 
    {% if company %} AND a.company = '{{ company }}' {% endif %}
GROUP BY 
    a.cost_center 
ORDER BY 
    SUM(a.grand_total) DESC
